title: Initiative burst control and error-budget swing simulator
creator: Leah Chen
description: Build a lightweight forecasting and decision-playbook tool (the 'swing simulator') that models short-term initiative bursts against error budget velocity and downstream SLI drift. Purpose: give PMs and SREs a single-pane scenario planner that answers: if Team X runs a 2-week feature burst (expected +15% request load and +10% latency p90), how will error budgets move across services and what mitigation gates should trigger (throttle, canary pause, routing fallback)?
acceptance_criteria: 1) Simulator ingests historical SLIs (latency p50/p90, availability, error rate) from the past 90 days and accepts manual perturbation inputs; 2) Produces a time-series forecast of error budget consumption per service and aggregated initiative risk; 3) Outputs a ranked set of gating recommendations (e.g., pause rollout, reduce concurrency, route to cheaper variant) with estimated recovery windows; 4) Exportable scenario JSON and a short report template for post-mortem and leadership review; 5) UX mockups validated with 2 PMs and 1 SRE, and backend prototype integration with Grafana dashboard and runtime throttle APIs.
success_metrics: 1) 80% of simulated scenarios within ±20% of observed SLI change in a blind validation set; 2) Reduce surprise rollback incidents attributed to rollout bursts by 30% in the next quarter; 3) PM/SRE satisfaction score >= 4.0 on pilot surveys (5-point scale).
risks_and_tradeoffs: - Forecast accuracy limited by data sparsity for low-traffic services; - Conservative gating recommendations may slow feature velocity (tradeoff between reliability vs. speed); - Adds coupling between roadmap planning and runtime controls (need strict ACLs + audit logging).
technical_notes: - Prototype will use a lightweight ARIMA + simple rule-based shock model for fast, explainable forecasts; - Data ingestion via existing SLI exporter into a dedicated 'swing-sim' STATS bucket; - Integration hooks: runtime throttle API (ENG-1842), rollout controller (ENG-2309), and Grafana alerting; - Plan to iterate model complexity only after pilot validates value.
